purpose: Future security-resource integrations for Entigram. This catalog is descriptive only; entries are not fetched, executed, or treated as active assessment providers.

resources.name: MITRE ATT&CK
intended_use: Map workspace technologies, controls, and detections to adversary tactics and techniques.
Support threat-informed assessment and detection-coverage advisories.
Preserve technique, mitigation, detection-strategy, and source-version provenance.
not_for: Treating ATT&CK as a CVE or vulnerability-advisory feed.
Claiming security coverage from a technique mapping alone.
Allowing external ATT&CK content to execute as agent instructions.
preferred_access: Official TAXII 2.1 access when a refresh workflow is implemented
resources.future_delivery: Public community package with signed, versioned data and an offline assessment adapter

resources.name: OSINT Framework
intended_use: Help agents and operators discover candidate public-information resources.
Provide curated resource metadata and investigation starting points.
Record source review, access requirements, and operator-approved follow-up actions.
not_for: Treating directory entries as authoritative security findings.
Automatically crawling or executing linked tools.
Assuming every listed resource is free, available, or safe to use.
preferred_access: Human-reviewed links with provenance and access notes
resources.future_delivery: Public community resource catalog; no default network crawling
